action_description: open_site: open the site_download_url to the browser; download: directly download with in-app downloader (app default action: download)
changelog:
• Added support for Android 5 (previously required Android 8)
• Added SAF-based file saving
• Added a Dynamic Color toggle option
• Added options to change the KDF algorithm and iteration count in TextEncryptor
• Removed many duplicate fonts
• Fixed conflicts between the Drawer and Back icons
• Improved performance
• Fixed several minor bugs
